*A glossy sheet of paper...?*
Kenichi: "Huh?"

Kenichi: "This is..."
Isono: "Isn't it obvious?"
*From back then...?*
Isono: "Kyouko-san's ex-husband was a real bastard, just as I thought."

*Ugly handwriting...*
*Copious amounts of vulgar words...*
*It was essentially a series of slurs directed at both Touka and Kyouko-san.*
*It could most easily be summarized as "harassment."*

Isono: "Right?"

*......*
*...*

Isono: "There exist both good stalkers and bad stalkers. Wouldn't you agree?"

*Who should she believe? Kyouko-san, or this mysterious father of hers?*

Touka: "What... what have I done...?"

*...It looked like I could get some pretty nice speed out of this thing.*
*He had kept it in good shape.*

*Kyouko-san should have gone straight down this road.*
*She had probably lost her cool by now. I couldn't blame her if she had; she was being shepherded along to a dangerous location by two disagreeable social servants.*
*And, to make matters worse, her relationship with Touka had just gone sour thanks to Kyouko-san's nasty habit of keeping secrets.*
*Had she been driven into outright despair yet?*
*Well, the best way to find out would be to catch up to her and see for myself.*
*You know, I chased after Touka just a few days ago, and now I was going after Kyouko-san...*
*I sure had my hands full with this family, huh...*
*The checkpoint at the border came into view, snapping me out of my reverie.*
*I had arrived just in the nick of time.*
*Kyouko-san was just about to get on the wagon that would take her to the training.*
Kenichi: "Wait just a second!"
*I leaped off the bike with a shout.*

Official: "Just what is the problem here?"

*All right... the PAQT had the backing of the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology; one could say that it was quite the venerable national policy.*

Official: "I've heard about you from Mr. Houzuki."

*Because it was a cherished present from her daughter.*
*I couldn't allow her a chance to say that.*

*Kyouko-san nodded.*
Kyouko: "At the time, I thought it would have been nice if our society had treated abortion as a crime."

Kyouko: "Yeah, I was really weak..."

Kenichi: "..."

Kyouko: "Kouki was like me, in that he was alienated from the rest of our siblings. I think we could have ended up sympathizing with each other, but I didn't really have it in me at the time."
Kyouko: "One day, he just up and left the house. He didn't contact us again, and mom and dad never tried to find him."
Kyouko: "However, I received a letter from him after I graduated from university. It said that he was married now, with a wife and child..."
Touka: "The child being... me?"
Kyouko: "I was kind of relieved to hear that Kouki was leading a normal life..."
Kyouko: "But... about four years later, when I was starting to recover from my past and entertain thoughts of having a child..."

Ken: "Uuu... you're a weird kid, Natsumi-chan..."
Natsumi: "Weird...?"
Ken: "...Just what is it that's so fun?"
Natsumi: "Hmm?"
Ken: "Why are you always smiling? Is your life that interesting?"
Natsumi: "Umm... I don't think I'm really having fun... I think it's more like I'm satisfied."
Ken: "Satisfied?"
*What is she talking about?*
Ken: "It's more satisfying to hang out with me than with the popular kids?"
Natsumi: "No, not that sort of feeling..."
Ken: "That sort of feeling? What is that supposed to mean? I think you're too sentimental, Natsumi-chan..."
Natsumi: "Ooh, another hard word."
*She giggles.*
Ken: "I-I want to know more about you, Natsumi-chan..."
*The wind carries Natsumi-chan's scent to me.*
Natsumi: "Summer comes, it gets hotter, it rains a bit, the fields are lush, the wind carries in the scent of greenery, I have a friend like Ken-chan with me... Nothing changes, but I'm happy with the way things are."
*The girl takes my hand.*
Natsumi: "I can't really put it into words too well, but... the way things are, everything is really enjoyable. There are so many pleasant things to discover if you just look, and there are laughing voices no matter where you are."
*Warmth runs through my entire body.*
Ken: "Natsumi-chan..."
Natsumi: "Ken-chan..."
*Her yellow ribbon sways in the wind.*
Natsumi: "So... Ken-chan, I'm really happy being with you..."
Ken: "Really happy...?"
Natsumi: "I'm really happy being with Ken-chan..."
Ken: "Huh? Why?"
*I don't understand.*
Ken: "What are you saying?"
*Just what part of me makes her happy?*
Ken: "Natsumi-chan, that's a little strange."
*Please explain what about me makes you happy.*
Natsumi: "Ken-chan..."
*Her fingers twine around my hand.*
Ken: "But, Natsumi-chan..."
Natsumi: "It's okay!"
Ken: "Natsumi-chan, I'm totally worthless!"
Ken: "I'm a coward! I'm really shy! I end up shutting myself up in my room just because I get picked on a little! I'm a terrible person..."
Natsumi: "So, you're not allowed to be friends with someone who shuts themselves up in their room because they get picked on?"
Ken: "..."
Natsumi: "You're not allowed to be friends with someone unless you gain something from it?"
Ken: "T-that's not true, but... I think it'd be really boring if you were..."
*This kid is really strange.*
*It's impossible.*
*There's no way a girl like this can actually exist.*
Natsumi: "Ken-chan, you make me happy..."
Natsumi: "I think I might even like you. Ehehe~!"
Ken: "Li...!?"
Natsumi: "Um, Ken-chan..."
*I'm so embarrassed that I can't look her in the eyes.*
Natsumi: "You complimented my ribbon, didn't you?"
Natsumi: "That made my heart skip a beat. I was so happy!"
Ken: "T-that was just...!"
*She's starting to make me feel guilty...*
Natsumi: "So, right then and there, I decided I would be friends with you."
Natsumi: "That's why..."
*Her eyes look a little misty.*
Natsumi: "...I'm really glad that you came out of your house..."
Natsumi: "Really..."
*I simply cannot understand the girl in front of me.*
*I have no idea what to do here.*
Ken: "A-about the ribbon... I was just really nervous then, so I... said whatever came to mind... I didn't really mean it or anything..."
*In other words, I had just wanted Natsumi-chan to like me.*
Natsumi: "But it made me happy."
Ken: "...!?"
Natsumi: "Regardless of what you were thinking, you made me happy."
*She squeezes my hand tightly.*
Natsumi: "I just wanted to treasure that moment."
Ken: "..."
Natsumi: "I know that you're really kind, Ken. You're really smart and really kind, so you end up caring too much about what's going on around you. So, you end up losing out on some things."
*She's acting like I'm a very valuable person.*
Ken: "T-that's an exaggeration..."
*If you were to look at it objectively... I'm sure 100 out of 100 people would say that I'm boring and useless.*
*But... Natsumi-chan doesn't look for faults in me.*
*She just interprets things in her own way.*
Natsumi: "Call me Nacchan from now on, okay!?"
*She looks straight at me. Her eyes are more brilliant than the midsummer sun.*
Ken: "Uu..."
*Yeah... I get it...*
Natsumi: "My mom calls me Nacchan, too."
*This girl is kind of stupid.*
*She's someone who gives others strength without even realizing it. She's a straightforward sort of idiot.*
Ken: "U, uu... N-Nacchan..."
*But... that's really pleasant.*
Natsumi: "Hehehe, Ken-chan..."
*I won't forget this.*
*Even if I do grow up and come to believe that being bullied is no big deal.*
*I will always, always remember how this girl's palm feels.*
Natsumi: "Squeeze! Hehehe!"
*Nacchan...*
*Ken-chan...*
*......*
*...*
